notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for an adapter-supplied rich FOM transportation type used by a timestamped ordinary attribute update. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, rich FOM, endpoint, callback model, logical-time implementation, and object, attribute, and transportation names. It verifies object and attribute handle/name round-trips, transportation handle/name round-trips, timestamped publication and subscription, registration, discovery, pre-grant delivery gating, immediate and time-constrained reflection, logical-time and order metadata, retraction callbacks, and received transportation identity without provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador FOM object, attribute, transportation, declaration, time-management, timestamped update, retraction, and lifecycle services with FederateAmbassador discovery, reflection, retraction, and time callbacks
